actualities.title: Suspicious IP activity targeting corporate VPNs
actualities.summary: Observed cluster of scans and brute-force attempts against corporate VPN endpoints.
actualities.content: Observed repeated connection attempts from multiple IPs belonging to a known scanning range. Indicators suggest automated scanning followed by credential stuffing attempts.

actualities.title: Phishing campaign uses brand impersonation
actualities.summary: A wide phishing campaign impersonating finance brand to harvest credentials.
actualities.content: Multiple phishing emails observed that mimic finance provider. Users in several orgs reported suspicious emails.
